help: Build a calculation from retained revisions. Original rows, exact values, exclusions and input locations remain inspectable. Results are stored in a new dataset revision and can feed figures and publication tables.
exactHelp: Version 3 arithmetic uses exact fractions and bounded integer powers, including negative powers. Zero to the zeroth power is one. Quotient truncates toward zero; remainder preserves a = quotient ? divisor + remainder. Floor and ceiling round in the authored unit. Optional declared units validate dimensions and convert exactly; labels alone make no dimensional claim. Unknown conditions keep conditional values absent and exclude selected rows.
title: Result dataset title
joinHelp: Match rows by one or more exact keys. Only one right-hand row may match each key. Use a right-hand condition to choose the baseline stage. Unmatched rows either stop the calculation or retain absent values.
whereHelp: Rows outside the selection remain in the retained dataset with this exclusion reason. Their calculated cells are absent.
removeLast: Remove dependent calculation steps and joined datasets from the end first, so column references remain correct.
name: Output column name
invalid: Complete the input, matching keys, conditions, numerical calculations and declared units. Column names must be unique. Check missing values, division by zero and ambiguous matches.
previewNote: First five acquisition rows. The complete dataset is checked when you retain it.
columnWindow: Columns {first}?{last} of {total}. Selected columns remain available.
projectionHelp: Choose the input columns included in this calculation. Up to 256 input and result columns can be retained per calculation. Other source columns remain unchanged.
invalidColumn: Choose a column number within this dataset.
conditionBudget: Keep conditions within 8 nested levels and 64 nodes, with 2 to 16 conditions per group. This change was not applied.
